svg.text: Roll the dice. Race to cell 100.
A server-driven Snakes & Ladders with sessions, a leaderboard and story events.
PHP rand(1,6) runs on each POST, never in the browser.
Positions, turns and roll history live in $_SESSION.
An AI Narrator describes each bonus, skip and warp.
Board preview, generated by a PHP loop
Primary action: the session check in index.php sends signed-in players to game.php
Header keeps two links only, Log in and Sign up, with no menu
Feature lines are text only: no icon tiles, gradients, shadows or glass panels
Preview is a static grid from a PHP loop, a hint of the 100-cell board
